newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$3 bln NCDs on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$3 bln NCDs on Saturday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Saturday it would issue T$3 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposit later in the day.
Bids would close at 10.30 local time (0230 GMT), a central bank official said.
The issue coincides with a renewed bull run in Taiwan's stock market, where the index has pushed to a series of seven-year highs in recent weeks.
On Saturday, the index rose 1.35 percent or 127.20 points at 9,521.83, hitting a seven-year intraday high.

The overnight and short-term money rates soared into double digits in late June as investors diverted holdings into stocks, and have been slowly rising again in the past week to stand well above the central bank's 5.0-5.5 percent target zone.
Some investors had also liquidated their foreign exchange holdings into Taiwan dollars, bolstering the local currency and halting what had been a slow, steady devaluation.
